book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Mɛɛle boo Jiso
Gɛ̀ bee kife kɛɛ le, nchi bu lɛ ba saŋ maŋkuŋ ma bamii bachii ba le yi bituŋ bi woŋ wu Lum le. Wu gɛ̀ bu a Kaisa Augustu wù gɛ̀ bee Nfoŋ wù baaŋ wu yo le.
Kintaŋ kinɛ gɛ̀ bee kì fwe kife kì Kwelino gɛ̀ bee muh wù baaŋ wu Lum wù gɛ̀ sage kimbe ki woŋ ki Silia le.
Noo, bamii bachii mo bo kaase bo tuu jiŋ bantɛ baboo le, lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo saŋ ajee aboo ki ba taŋ bo.
Yosɛf tɛ mo wu ja Nasalɛ ntɛ wumu wu Galalee le, wu bɛɛŋ wu gɛɛŋ Bɛtɛhɛm kimbe ki woŋ ki Judia le a ba gɛ̀ boyɛ Nfoŋ Dabi yo. Wu gɛ̀ gɛnɛ yo nje wù gɛ̀ bee muh wu a kfuu chi Nfoŋ Dabi le.
Yosɛf gɛ̀ gɛɛne bɛ Mɛɛle wù wu gɛ̀ lesɛ lɛ wu lé wu gê wù nyu kwɛɛ ki bo saŋ ajee, wù nyu bɛ fwe.
No bo gɛ̀ gɛnɛ bo bu yo, kife ke ki boyɛ to ki kojɛ.
Wu boo mwa ye wu bvuchile nyu mwa wù jwɛŋsɛ, wu kujɛ a nju le, wu giŋsɛ a ŋguh wu nyáŋ le, nje bo gɛ̀ kɛme gɛ kibuu ki kinche ki bamii ba jiɛnyi le gɛ.
Nchɛndaa wu Tada sɛɛŋ boyɛ bamii ba chiɛɛne shóŋ le
Gɛ̀ bee kife kiyu le, bamii ba chiɛɛne kiji ki shóŋ bamu nyu mbebe ntɛ wɛɛ le, bo chiɛɛne shóŋ yiboo antaŋ.
Nchɛndaa wu Tada jâgɛ nɛ wu bu a bo jii, n'yuu wù Nyo baaŋ fɛ bo gɛ̀ bee fo, bo kɛmɛ nfaaŋ baaŋ.
Geenɛ, nchɛndaa wu Tada wuyu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ. Bɛŋ yû, ntoo nyu bɛ saaka wù joŋe fɛ bɛŋ le, wu lé wu gê wu nyâ njoŋ wù baaŋ fɛ bamii le bachii.
Yi juu chi abɛŋ le ba le ba boo Mbvusɛ ntɛ wu Nfoŋ Dabi le wù le Kletu wù Tada.
Finɛ le nyu njiŋɛ ki wu dûnyɛ mwa wuyu bɛŋ le. Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ wu le ba kujɛ a nju le ba giŋsɛ a ŋguh wu nyáŋ le.”
Gɛh noo, bo ja bo jaŋɛ bo yɛŋ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wɛɛ le bɛ kinchvu ki bamu ba duude le bo tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo bo duu lɛ,

content.text: “Mbɛɛŋsɛ nyûme fɛ Nyo wù le fɛwe le,
kimbonɛ nyume fɛkuu fɛnɛ fɛ bamii ba Nyo yuge njoŋ bɛ bo le.”

content: Sege banchɛndaa ba Nyo baa gɛ̀ ja bo chinɛ bo le bo kaasɛ bo bɛɛŋ fɛwe, bamii ba chiɛɛne shóŋ bayu jɛmɛ ye yiboo le lɛ, “Bee gɛ̂ɛŋ mɛɛse wunɛ Bɛtɛhɛm, bee gɛ̂ɛŋ be yɛ̂ŋ fiɛɛ finɛ fi kooshi le fì Nyo le wu ge lɛ bee kɛɛ.”
Fo ki sege, bo mo bo ja bo gɛɛne chige chige, bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ Yosɛf bɛ Mɛɛle mo mwa, wu gime a ŋguh wu nyáŋ le.
No bo yɛŋ noo, bo mo bo kɛ bo feeji mwɛɛ munchii mu nchɛndaa wu Nyo be sɛŋe bo le kune mwa wuyu.
Jwe yuŋ bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yu mwɛɛ mù bamii ba chiɛɛne shóŋ baa gɛ̀ jɛme bo le.
Geenɛ, Mɛɛle yu wu gɛɛ fɛ fitele fie le wu tu wu kwaji segechii.
Bamii ba chiɛɛne shóŋ baa kaase bo tuu jiŋ bo yuuse Nyo bo tume maŋkuŋ mɛ nje bo gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ mwɛɛ munchii nyu gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no nchɛndaa wu Nyo gɛ̀ sɛŋe.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo nya mwa wu Jiso yeh yi kintanyɛ ki Nyo le
Mwa wuyu bu aju nyaaŋ, ba chvuu wu yeh, ba mo ba chu wu jee lɛ Jiso, jee chinɛ nyu gɛh chi chì nchɛndaa wu Nyo gɛ̀ sɛŋe bwee le fɛ wu ge wu kɛmɛ fwe.
Kife gɛ̀ kojɛ kì ba ge kintanyɛ ki ba kfuŋ bikwɛɛ biboo no nchi wu Musɛ gɛ̀ goone. Bo mo bo jo mwa bo bɛɛŋ bɛ wu Yɛlusalɛm ki bo gɛɛŋ bo nya Tada le.
Finɛ le no ba gɛ̀ saŋ a ŋwa wu banchi ba Tada le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh nɛ le wu boo mwa wu bvuchile nyume mwa wu jwɛŋsɛ,

content: Bo gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ tɛ ki bo ge kintanyɛ kinɛ bɛ bimbɛmbɛ bifɛɛ, no nyu bɛ booŋ ba mundoŋɛ bafɛɛ bii no fi gɛ̀ bee a Ŋwa wu banchi ba Tada le.

Lɛ nyu kife kiyu le, chiji la wumu nyu Yɛlusalɛm ba tɛŋe lɛ Simuŋ. Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wù chaaŋ wù gee no Nyo goone, wu gɛ̀ chiɛɛne muh wù lé wu gê wu tô ki wu jîɛɛsɛ muntele mu bamii ba Ishwala. Kiyo ki Yuude gɛ̀ bee yi ye ye le,
Ki gɛ̀ ge wa wu kɛɛ lɛ gɛ kwe nyu yi jo wu, njɛ wu yɛŋ muh wu Mbvusɛ wù Tada gɛ̀ ka le gɛ.
Kiyo ki Yuude ja ki ge Simuŋ gɛɛŋ yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Yosɛf bɛ Mɛɛle gɛ̀ doo bo to bɛ mwa yeh yi kintanyɛ le ki bo ge no nchi gɛ̀ goone,
Simuŋ fi mwa wu kɛmɛ wu mo wu kɛ wu tu wu tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo, wu duu lɛ,

content.text: “Tada, no wo le wo ge wa ŋka wo wu to wu kojɛ,
jôo lɛ muh wo wu lɛme yi kimbonɛ le.
Ajii a waŋ le wo yɛŋ wa Mbvusɛ le,
wù wo le wo chiiŋsɛ le, bamii bachii lé bo gê bo yɛ̂ŋ wu le.
Wu lé wu gê wù nyû kin'yesɛ fɛ bamii ba kee gɛ Nyo gɛ, wu lɛ bo tɛ kee wo, wu gê bo bɛ̂ɛŋse jee chi bamii buŋ ba Ishwala we.”

content: Chiji mwa bɛ bwe mwa yu mwɛɛ mu Simuŋ jɛme kune mwa wunɛ, jwe yuŋ bo.

Wu mo wu gɛɛ kimbonɛ ye yiboo le, wu jɛmɛ Mɛɛle wu bwee le lɛ, “Nyo le wu cha wa mwa yo wunɛ, nto we lé wu gê bamii ba Ishwala ba duude bo gwêeyi, bamu jâde lo we. Wu le njiŋɛ wu fiɛɛ fì bamii lé bo gê bo jɛ̂me mwɛɛ yi ye ye le.
Noo, finɛ mo fi duunyi mwɛɛ mù bamii nyile a muntele muboo le. Mwɛɛ munɛ munchii lé mu gê fitele fiuŋ nyu njɛ ba le ba booŋ bɛ finyoo.”

Gɛ̀ bee gɛh kife kiyu le, kwɛse wumu nyu ba tɛŋe lɛ Ana, wù nyu muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo. Wu gɛ̀ bee mwa Fanuel wu le muh wu a kfuu chi Ashɛl le. Kwɛse wɛɛ gɛ̀ bee wu juŋ wa baaŋ. Wu gɛ̀ bee bɛ jwɛɛŋ gɛh yi biluŋ le bvusooshwi maa, jwɛɛŋ mo wu kwe.
Wu tu wù nyu gɛh wa fie kwɛŋkfu, wu shee yeh yi kintanyɛ le wu yuuse Nyo antaŋ bɛ fɛnshe, wu banɛ mwɛɛ munjile, wu buune. Biluŋ bie gɛ̀ bee wa mbanyaaŋ ncho binɛh (84).

Gɛh kife kiyu le kì ba gɛ̀ to bɛ mwa yeh yi kintanyɛ le, kwɛse wɛɛ gɛ̀ yɛŋ bo le, wu mo wu nya kiyone fɛ Nyo le, wu jɛmɛ kune mwa wunɛ bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne kife kì Nyo le wu suuŋ bamii ba Yɛlusalɛm chiaaŋ yi ŋgɛ le.
Sege Yosɛf bɛ Mɛɛle gɛ̀ mɛsɛ mwɛɛ munchii no nchi wù Nyo gɛ̀ goone, bo mo bo kaase bo tuu jiŋ ntɛ wuboo wu Nasalɛ le a kimbe ki woŋ kì Galalee le.
Mwa wuyu mo wu tu wu kuu wù kɛme bvuŋga, wu yisɛ bɛ bvufee bvu baaŋ, chiaaŋ yi Nyo nyume yi ye ye le.
Jiso gɛɛŋ wu shɛɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ ki Nyo le
Chiji Jiso bɛ bwee gɛ̀ bɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm biluŋ bichii fɛ Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe le.
Jiso gɛ̀ bu biluŋ yuufe ncho bifɛɛ, bo ka bo bɛɛŋ fɛ ŋka wɛɛ le gɛh no bo gɛ̀ to bo bɛɛne.
No bo gɛ̀ ji wa Ŋka bo mɛsɛ, bo doo bo kaase bo tuu jiŋ, mwa wù Jiso shɛɛ ajiŋ Yɛlusalɛm, geenɛ chiji bɛ bwee gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ.
Bo jiɛnyɛ juu chi chile, bo kwaji gɛh lɛ wu le antɛnɛɛ a ŋgoo yi bamii ba bɛ bo gɛ̀ jiɛnyi le. Bo mo bo kɛ bo goone wu antɛnɛɛ a kfuu chiboo bɛ nsáa yiboo,
lɛ bo gooŋ sɛɛŋ, bo mo bo kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ Yɛlusalɛm ki bo gooŋ wu yo.
Gɛh doo nyume ajiŋ a aju atade no bo gɛ̀ kɛ bo goone wu, bo yɛŋ wu le nyu yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu shii yu bɛ bamii ba n'yɛyɛ, wu yege ba n'yɛyɛ, wu biide ba mbilɛ.
Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yege mo bo kɛmɛ ŋgha baaŋ nje wu gɛ̀ kee mwɛɛ baaŋ wu ka chvuse bambilɛ chuule.
No bwee bɛ chiji yɛŋ wu le, de yuŋ bo. Bwee bɛɛŋ wu wu du lɛ, “Mwa wo jeese la bɛ bee nɛ? Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, besa chijo le bɛ gooŋ wa wo bee tu be wɛɛse lo.”
Wu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ be goone mɛ nje la? Gɛ bɛŋ be kee lɛ ŋkɛmɛ ki nyûme a chii yeh fɛnɛ gɛ?”

content: Geenɛ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ jɛme gɛ.
Wu mo wu ja bɛ bo boge Nasalɛ. Wu gɛɛŋ wu yuge bo le chuule. No mwɛɛ munɛ gɛ̀ kooshi nɛ, bwee gɛɛ fɛ fitele fie le wu kwaji segechii.
Jiso mo wu kuu, wù kɛme bvufee bvù baaŋ, Nyo koŋe wu, bamii tɛ koŋe wu.
